KitchenDesign.title: KitchenDesign
KitchenDesign.description: A complete 2D/3D architectural kitchen design project with room dimensions, materials, total cost, and serialized JSON layout

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID who owns this kitchen design

title.description: Human-readable name of the kitchen project

elementCount.description: Number of kitchen units/appliances in the design

totalCostUsd.description: Automatically calculated total project cost in USD

materialsCostUsd.description: Total cost of cabinets, boards, countertops, and aluminum profiles in USD

laborCostUsd.description: Estimated workshop assembly and installation labor cost in USD

accessoriesCostUsd.description: Total cost of smart internal kitchen accessories and hardware in USD

primaryMaterialId.description: Identifier of the primary kitchen finish/material

countertopMaterialId.description: Identifier of the countertop stone/marble/granite material

projectJson.description: Full serialized KitchenProject JSON snapshot for 2D/3D restoration

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the design was first created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the design was last updated

KitchenComponent.title: KitchenComponent
KitchenComponent.description: An individual kitchen unit (cabinet, drawer, corner unit, appliance, or custom photo-designed cabinet) stored in Firestore with size, category, coordinates, and unit price

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID who owns this kitchen component

designId.description: ID of the parent kitchen design or 'catalog_custom' for reusable user units

nameAr.description: Arabic name of the kitchen unit

category.description: Category of the unit (CABINETS, DRAWERS, APPLIANCES, CORNERS, ISLANDS)

elevationCm.description: Mounting elevation from floor in centimeters

unitPriceUsd.description: Automatically calculated unit cost in USD based on dimensions and material

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the component was saved

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the component was updated

/users/{userId}/kitchen_designs/{designI.description: Per-user saved 2D/3D kitchen designs with automatic cost breakdown and full JSON layout

/users/{userId}/kitchen_components/{comp.description: Per-user saved kitchen components/units with size, 2D/3D coordinates, material, and price
